decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted EX00, EX01.1, EX01.3 rev A, EX03, EX04, EX05, EX06, EX07, P01.3 rev A, P06, P07 received 10/04/2012, P01.1 rev C, P02 rev A, P03 rev B, P04 rev C, P05 rev B, P08 rev A received 30/05/2012 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and erection of a rear roof extension incorporating one front roof light to the house
